definitions.gloss: no matter how much, however much
definitions.explanation: Expresses that regardless of the degree or amount, the result is the same.

examples.japanese: いくら{説明|せつめい}しても{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, they don't understand.

notes:
いくら～ても expresses "no matter how much" - indicating that the result remains the same regardless of the degree or effort.

PATTERN:
いくら + verb (て form) + も

EXAMPLES:
- いくら{説明|せつめい}しても: no matter how much I explain
- いくら{食|た}べても: no matter how much I eat
- いくら{待|ま}っても: no matter how long I wait
- いくら{頑張|がんば}っても: no matter how hard I try

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- どんなに～ても: no matter how (emphasis on manner/degree)
- {何度|なんど}～ても: no matter how many times
- たとえ～ても: even if ~

NOTE:
Often implies frustration or resignation about unchanging results.
